stem.text: Which statement helps to explain why there is no cartilage in the walls of the bronchioles?

A.text: Cartilage would make the bronchioles too narrow.

B.text: Gases must diffuse across the walls of the bronchioles.

C.text: Smooth muscle is sufficient to support the walls of the bronchioles.

D.text: The bronchiole walls do not need to change shape.
